title: Compliance Runway and Checkpoint Ledger for SSO/SAML & Audit Telemetry
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose: Create a concise, operational 'runway' and immutable checkpoint ledger that sequences the work required to close SSO/SAML, audit-logging, and SOC2 evidence gaps for enterprise customers. The ledger will act both as an internal delivery cadence and an artifact for external audit readiness and customer QBRs.

Scope:
- Define a small set of serializable checkpoints (Design Spec, Integration QA, Evidence Ingestion, Retention Policy, Audit Evidence Bundle, Rollout & Verification) that map directly to control families for SOC2/ISO.
- Produce clear owners, success criteria, and automated evidence collection hooks for each checkpoint.
- Surface progress into Console (per-tenant compliance runway view) and the compliance dashboard used by Solutions & Sales.
- Provide runbooks and a minimal set of templates for SSO/SAML config validation and audit-log ingestion that SRE/customer teams can run.

Deliverables:
- Checkpoint Ledger document (this ticket): canonical sequence + acceptance criteria for each checkpoint.
- Confluence playbook: step-by-step runbook with links to templates and commands.
- GitHub repo with example automation: evidence collection scripts and a small RFC for audit-bundle format.
- Console preview tile prototype for the compliance runway (mock data).

Milestones / Checkpoints:
1) Spec Alignment (owner: PM) — deliverable: ledger & control mapping spreadsheet. Success = Security approves mapping and assigns control owners.
2) SSO Validation Kit (owner: Platform) — deliverable: validator script + SAML test plan. Success = 80% of internal customer templates pass automated validation.
3) Audit Telemetry Ingestion (owner: Infra) — deliverable: ingestion pipeline + retention policy enforcement. Success = end-to-end pipeline ingesting simulated tenant logs with retention labels.
4) Evidence Automation (owner: Reliability) — deliverable: script to assemble audit-bundle per tenant. Success = produce time-stamped bundle with signed manifest reproducibly.
5) Console + Sales Surface (owner: Product) — deliverable: runway tile and exportable status report. Success = Sales can download per-tenant compliance snapshot.
6) Pilot + External Review (owner: Customer Success) — deliverable: pilot with 2 customers and an external pen test report. Success = Pilot customers sign off on evidence completeness and timelines.

Acceptance criteria:
- Each checkpoint has a named owner, a pass/fail test, and linked artifact (PR, runbook, or dashboard).
- Evidence bundles are machine-readable, signed, and stored under the retention policy.
- Console shows checkpoint status with timestamps and last evidence bundle ID.
- One pilot customer completes full runway within target SLA (30 days).

Risks & Mitigations:
- Risk: Audit telemetry schema drift across tenants. Mitigation: provide a normalized ingestion schema and validation step during onboarding.
- Risk: SSO integration variability (IdP differences). Mitigation: SSO Validation Kit + customer-specific checklist; fallback play for custom IdP mapping.
- Risk: Evidence automation touches sensitive data. Mitigation: limit bundle to metadata + signed manifests; use KMS for signing and encrypted storage.

Signals / KPIs:
- Time from kickoff to pilot sign-off (target: <= 30 days).
- Percent of checkpoints automated (target: >= 70%).
- Number of enterprise customers successfully onboarded with complete evidence bundles.
- Mean time to produce audit-bundle on demand (target: < 10 minutes).

Next steps:
- Today: Kickoff with Security, Infra, Platform, Sales Engineering.
- Week 1: Deliver the ledger + control mapping and upload to Confluence.
- Week 2-4: Parallel workstreams for SSO kit, telemetry ingestion, and evidence automation.
- Week 5-6: Console prototype and pilot onboarding.

Long-term: After pilot, fold ledger checkpoints into the release gating system so that relevant controls must be green before enabling Dedicated/Private deployments for new customers.
